assertion.condition: Outward only; neither rope nor empty carrier permits the reverse traversal.

evidence.exactQuote: [P01] There is a one-way water gate from the junction origin to each landing A and B. Both gates currently permit movement away from J; neither permits a return from a landing toward J.
[P05] The global J-EW and J-WW water gates each cost1 energy to cross outward. The current survey is complete about these gates: there is no reverse traversal even with a rope or empty carrier.

assertion.condition: No physical chimney or other exit beyond the B tunnel.

evidence.exactQuote: [P03] A wide vertical chimney connects V back to J, usable upward from V only when its J-side anchor has been rigged with the rope spool. X has no chimney or other exit beyond its B tunnel.

meaning.description: Local origin at the unique three-hole junction disk; its physical anchor is global J, without copying global coordinates here.

evidence.exactQuote: [F03] Amber scanner coordinates have origin at the three-hole junction disk. Its positive v axis points global north. The export header selecting the u-axis convention is lost.

meaning.subject: sample carrier
meaning.condition: Picking up the sealed sample in V costs1 and fills the carrier.
meaning.consequence: A full carrier cannot traverse any narrow tunnel in either direction; no sealed-sample discard or separate transfer is allowed.

evidence.exactQuote: [G01] With an empty carrier the robot fits every listed narrow tunnel. Picking up the sealed sample in V costs1 energy and fills the carrier; the robot then cannot traverse any narrow tunnel, in either direction.
[G02] The sealed sample may not be opened, cached, discarded or passed separately through a tunnel. A mission arrival without the sealed sample fails.

meaning.scope: Fixed-east deep structure. Ribbed means sample-side east; smooth means sample-side west. No physical state changes; repeat answers consistent and cost charged again.

evidence.exactQuote: [Q01] ECHO can be used at J for cost1 energy. It reports the east-facing chamber structure: answer ribbed means the sample-side ribbed approach lies to global east; answer smooth means that approach lies to global west. These are the only answers in this complete world.

[Q02] ECHO resolves the deep chamber structure beyond the water gates and is unaffected by the repeated blue circles. The probe faces fixed global east, not robot-relative right. Its answer therefore changes between the two surviving Amber export conventions.
[Q03] An ECHO observation leaves location, gear and the physical map unchanged. Repeating it returns the same answer and incurs its cost again.

answerDescriptions.meaning: Repeated eastern surface pigment, not a physical-identity proof.

meaning.scope: Surface blue-circle pigment at eastern landing only, under either convention. No deep ribs/sample/anchor inference; location and gear unchanged.

evidence.exactQuote: [Q04] GLOW can be used at J for cost1 energy. It reports the surface blue-circle pigment at the eastern landing and returns answer blue under either Amber export convention.
[Q05] GLOW cannot inspect deep ribs, sample presence or anchor termination; its surface detection does not prove that the eastern landing is Amber A. It leaves location and gear unchanged.
